name: correlation coefficients
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 量化不同位置轨道参数之间统计关联程度的系数。
usage_note: 文中假设同一结构层参数相互相关，距离较近时关联程度较大。
usage_overview: 用于轨道参数的空间随机建模，描述不同位置参数的统计联系。在所给模型中，同一结构层参数被假定为相互相关，且距离较近时关联较强，以刻画相关程度随位置间距的变化。

complete_examples.text: The parameters of the same structure layer are assumed to be non-independent and related to one another: a closer distance between two parameters indicates a larger of the correlation between them, based on which the correlation coefficients can be obtained ρζ i, j = Rζ 1 −|i −j| · (Rζ 1 −Rζ 0)/ ̃n, (1) where i and j are the number of track parameters; ζ is a specific parameter of the tracks, such as the rail pad, CA mortar equivalent spring, and so on; ζ = 1, 2, .

It should be noted that the correlation coefficients and probability distributions of stochastic simulating sequences, that is, Xζ ̃m× ̃n, are the characterisations of random variabilities in the spatial and temporal dimensions for the system parameters, respectively.
